title: Remove auto-generated inventory counts from Hunch documentation
context: Hunch grounding statements across 5 documentation files contained dynamically-generated record counts (264 decisions, 2 bugs, 28 constraints, etc.). These counts required regeneration whenever the underlying Hunch graph changed, creating staleness and maintenance burden.
decision: Strip the record-count sentence from all Hunch documentation. Keep the description of what Hunch is and how to access it, but remove the inventory snapshot. Direct users to query the live Hunch system via MCP tools rather than reading stale counts from docs.
consequences: Documentation remains accurate without regeneration cycles
Eliminates toil from maintaining counts across 5 separate files
Single source of truth shifts from docs to the actual Hunch system
Slight loss of at-a-glance Hunch scale visibility, mitigated by MCP tool availability
alternatives_rejected: Keep static counts and update manually (creates staleness and toil)
Automate count regeneration in build pipeline (adds unnecessary tooling for ephemeral metadata)
Use a central config file that docs include (does not solve staleness, only dedupes effort)
